gramlot.binding.summary: Values and widget policy shared by data-aware Gramlot fields.

parameters.name: value
parameters.doc: Literal value or an existing ^/= data path expression.

parameters.name: dtype
parameters.doc: Optional dtype metadata; the component contract does not restrict its vocabulary.

parameters.name: default
parameters.doc: Existing default policy value, preserved without narrowing its type.

parameters.name: default_value
parameters.doc: Existing explicit default value, including false and empty-string values.

parameters.name: blankIsNull
parameters.doc: Blank-value policy; a string also permits the existing ^/= binding syntax.

gramlot.decoration.summary: Shared widget label and box decoration.

parameters.name: lbl
parameters.doc: Widget label text or a ^/= data path expression.

parameters.name: lbl_position
parameters.doc: Label placement: L, R, TL, TC, TR, BL, BC or BR.

gramlot.validation.summary: Validation rules consumed by the shared form service.

open_patterns.doc: A supported validation rule such as validate_notnull or validate_len.
